purpose: idle loop (mono, 10 s + 0.5 s head repeat)
author: KVV_Audio
notes: Hyundai Kona (small SUV) static idle, exterior, 96 kHz source. Steady harmonic comb on 24.0 Hz (72/120/144/168/216 Hz); strongest lines 72 and 75 Hz. RMS -24 dBFS.

purpose: constant-RPM drone for speed pitch-shifting (mono, 9 s + 0.5 s head repeat)
author: craigsmith
notes: 'Constant Fast Car Engine'. Source drifted 95-108 Hz; varispeed-flattened (time-varying resample tracking the 3rd-order line) to 102.7 +/-0.2 Hz over 0.6-29.1 s of the original, then looped from 0.5 s of the flattened take. Weaker half-order comb every 17.1 Hz underneath (137, 205, 257 Hz...). Source rolls off above ~3 kHz. RMS -24 dBFS.

purpose: tyre/road roll loop (stereo, 20 s + 0.5 s head repeat)
author: klankbeeld
notes: Inside car at 90 km/h on asphalt, steady broadband roll (-22 dBFS per 1 s window, no bumps). Recorded in the cabin, so it is warm/low (little above 2 kHz) with a faint engine line near 110 Hz. RMS -24 dBFS.

author: Audy_Leonard
notes: Duration 120 ms; attack at 3.8 ms, peak -3 dB at 10.5 ms. Cut from a decoded WAV (mp3 -ss seeks were ~10 ms off). Lower click (centroid ~870 Hz).

author: Audy_Leonard
notes: Duration 120 ms; attack at 2.0 ms, peak -3 dB at 5.8 ms. Same recording as tick, 0.4 s later; brighter click (centroid ~2.2 kHz), 8 dB quieter in the source (normalised to -3 dB peak like tick).

author: DangerLaef
notes: Volvo XC40 exterior door close; solid low thunk (spectral centroid ~180 Hz), quiet background. Onset ~5 ms, peak -3 dB.

author: AlexanderChe
notes: Chevrolet Lacetti 1.4 petrol. Key click, ~0.5 s crank, catch at ~0.6 s, flare peaking ~0.9 s, dropping toward idle by the 0.9 s fade-out. Peak -3 dB.

author: AlexanderChe
notes: Same Lacetti 1.4 take: ~0.45 s of idle, key click, engine shudders down and stops. Peak -3 dB.
